data.body:
**[P2] Enforce the deadline during connection establishment**

`conn.sock` remains `None` while `socket.create_connection()` resolves DNS and attempts addresses, so expiry cannot interrupt that work. A later address may connect and the POST may be sent after the deadline; because `expired` is checked only after exceptions, this can even return success. Use a deadline-aware connection routine that exposes/closes the in-flight socket and checks expiry before sending and returning, with a test where an initial address stalls before a reachable address.
